items: NABL under Quality Council of India (QCI) launched India's first accreditation scheme for mobile food testing labs.
**Program Framework:** Integrated Assessment Programme launched by NABL (Quality Council of India constituent).
**NABL Governance:** HQ: New Delhi; Chairperson: Dr. Sandip Shah.
≠ **NABL Nodal:** NABL is a constituent board of QCI (DPIIT).
